title: Beyond the Bohr-Kronecker Torus Barrier: Semiprime Phase-Locking, Quantized Hadamard-Krein Flux Defects pi*Theta(d - d_*), and the Exact Chladni-Wronskian Wall Identity for Riemann's Xi-Function
description: Paper X of the series on the Transverse Wronskian of Riemann's Xi-Function. Establishes three structural closure theorems beyond the Bohr-Kronecker / Voronin torus barrier: (1) the exponential Bohr-Kronecker recurrence time bound T_Kronecker(t) >> t and the exact semiprime quadratic restoration identity |1 + P_{>X}(s) + 1/2 P_{>X}(s)^2|^2 = 1/4 ((1+U)^2 + 1 - V^2)^2 + V^2(1+U)^2 >= 1/4 on V=0; (2) the quantized Hadamard-Krein flux-defect law int_{-infty}^{infty} K(d, d_*, u) du = pi*Theta(d - d_*), proving that any off-critical zero pair suffers a -pi topological flux defect across 0 < d < d_* and forces a Sylvester inertia jump nu_- >= 1 in the de Branges reproducing-kernel Gram matrix; and (3) the exact 1D Chladni-Wronskian Wall Identity W_tilde(d, tau_k(d)) = R(d, tau_k(d)) * d_t I(d, tau_k(d)) / d along imaginary nodal curves I(d, tau_k(d)) = 0 coupled with Jacobi triple-product zero-freeness in |Im(u)| < pi/8.
